guitar.evidence: John Frusciante's vintage Fender Stratocasters (and some Telecasters/Jaguars) are well documented across the band's biggest albums (Californication, By the Way).

tone.target: jangly clean edge-of-breakup with bright chorusy shimmer
tone.profile: jangly clean edge-of-breakup with bright chorusy shimmer
tone.summary: A chimey, compressed signal chain using a US Deluxe/Silver Twin style amp paired with Chorus and Room reverb to achieve the jangly, shimmering sound of 'Scar Tissue'.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, chimey sound of a Fender-style clean amp.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the clean tone.
Add the required 'chorusy shimmer' and jangle to the clean tone.
Brighten the top end and enhance the single-coil bite.
Add subtle space and shimmer without sounding like a wash.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and brightness for the jangly, shimmering sound.
